Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Add a native freecam ("/posekit tfc" or the main-window button): fly the camera independently with WASD/E/Q and right-drag to look, while your character's own controls stay locked and posing stays untouched. Freecam exits automatically on zoning, logout, GPose, or cutscenes, and restores your original camera settings.
